answer_1.quote: End-to-end fine-tuning of pre-trained language models like GPT-2 or T5 on downstream tasks has been an immensely popular training paradigm for text generation in the last few years.
answer_1.outputs: quatrains with rhyme scheme, meter, and alliteration constraints

answer_2.quote: We define the following metrics: Rhyme Score computes the recall of verses that should rhyme in a quatrain, as well as the recall of verses that should not and takes their arithmetic average. Alliteration Score is 1 if a quatrain has the correct alliteration level, else 0. Meter Score is the fraction of verses with correctly classified meters. Coherence uses BERT for next sentence prediction to assess discourse relations of verses.

answer_4.quote: To further validate the effectiveness of our models, we conduct a human evaluation campaign using best-worst scaling (BWS) as a means of annotation.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are presented with tuples of n items (usually n = 4) and asked to identify the best and worst item based on a specified property.
